# BLACK CROW **Managed proxy subscription infrastructure** ![Subscriptions](https://img.shields.io/badge/Subscriptions-20-0b0f19?style=for-the-badge) ![Capacity](https://img.shields.io/badge/Capacity-40%2C000-0b0f19?style=for-the-badge) ![Bot Feed](https://img.shields.io/badge/Bot_Feed-5%2C000-0b0f19?style=for-the-badge) ![Refresh](https://img.shields.io/badge/Refresh-Every_3h-0b0f19?style=for-the-badge) [Telegram Channel](https://t.me/nukcrow)  |  [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/nukcrow/black-crow)
--- ## Overview | | | |---|---| | **Subscriptions** | 20 independent feeds, up to 2,000 configurations each | | **Bot Feed** | 1 dedicated feed, up to 5,000 configurations | | **Protocols** | VLESS, VMess, Trojan, Shadowsocks | | **Validation** | TCP reachability, TLS / WebSocket handshake, end-to-end proxy request (VLESS and Trojan) | | **Selection** | Port, host and subnet diversity limits, so no single port dominates a feed | | **Refresh** | Automatically every 3 hours | | **Tag** | `#nukcrow` on every configuration | --- ## Quick Start 1. Copy the link of any subscription below. 2. Open your client and choose **Add subscription** (or *Import from URL*). 3. Paste the link, update the subscription, then run a latency test and connect. > Start with **Subscription 01**. If it is unstable on your network, move to the next one. Compatible with v2rayNG, v2rayN, Hiddify, Streisand and any client that supports standard subscription links. --- ## Subscriptions ### Priority Tier (01 - 05) Highest-ranked configurations: validated end to end where possible and ordered by quality. | ID | Tier | Capacity | Link | |:--:|:--|:--:|:--| | **01** | Priority | 2,000 | [`sub1.txt`](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nukcrow/black-crow/main/sub/general/sub1.txt) | | **02** | Priority | 2,000 | [`sub2.txt`](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nukcrow/black-crow/main/sub/general/sub2.txt) | | **03** | Priority | 2,000 | [`sub3.txt`](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nukcrow/black-crow/main/sub/general/sub3.txt) | | **04** | Priority | 2,000 | [`sub4.txt`](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nukcrow/black-crow/main/sub/general/sub4.txt) | | **05** | Priority | 2,000 | [`sub5.txt`](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nukcrow/black-crow/main/sub/general/sub5.txt) | ### Standard Tier (06 - 10) Balanced coverage and diversity. | ID | Tier | Capacity | Link | |:--:|:--|:--:|:--| | **06** | Standard | 2,000 | [`sub6.txt`](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nukcrow/black-crow/main/sub/general/sub6.txt) | | **07** | Standard | 2,000 | [`sub7.txt`](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nukcrow/black-crow/main/sub/general/sub7.txt) | | **08** | Standard | 2,000 | [`sub8.txt`](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nukcrow/black-crow/main/sub/general/sub8.txt) | | **09** | Standard | 2,000 | [`sub9.txt`](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nukcrow/black-crow/main/sub/general/sub9.txt) | | **10** | Standard | 2,000 | [`sub10.txt`](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nukcrow/black-crow/main/sub/general/sub10.txt) | ### Extended Tier (11 - 20) Maximum volume. Direct links (copy and paste) ```text https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nukcrow/black-crow/main/sub/general/sub1.txt https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nukcrow/black-crow/main/sub/general/sub2.txt https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nukcrow/black-crow/main/sub/general/sub3.txt https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nukcrow/black-crow/main/sub/general/sub4.txt https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nukcrow/black-crow/main/sub/general/sub5.txt https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nukcrow/black-crow/main/sub/general/sub6.txt https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nukcrow/black-crow/main/sub/general/sub7.txt https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nukcrow/black-crow/main/sub/general/sub8.txt https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nukcrow/black-crow/main/sub/general/sub9.txt https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nukcrow/black-crow/main/sub/general/sub10.txt https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nukcrow/black-crow/main/sub/general/sub11.txt https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nukcrow/black-crow/main/sub/general/sub12.txt https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nukcrow/black-crow/main/sub/general/sub13.txt https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nukcrow/black-crow/main/sub/general/sub14.txt https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nukcrow/black-crow/main/sub/general/sub15.txt https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nukcrow/black-crow/main/sub/general/sub16.txt https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nukcrow/black-crow/main/sub/general/sub17.txt https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nukcrow/black-crow/main/sub/general/sub18.txt https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nukcrow/black-crow/main/sub/general/sub19.txt https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nukcrow/black-crow/main/sub/general/sub20.txt https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nukcrow/black-crow/main/sub/general/bot.txt ```
How configurations are selected 1. Sources are collected from curated public repositories and Iran-focused collectors. 2. Invalid, duplicate and insecure entries are removed (for example VLESS without TLS). 3. Each configuration is scored on protocol, transport, security, port, SNI / Host and CDN fronting. 4. Candidates are tested for TCP reachability, then TLS and WebSocket handshake, then an end-to-end proxy request where the protocol allows. 5. Final lists are built tier by tier, with limits per port, host and subnet.
Important notes - Checks run from outside Iran. They confirm that a server is alive and proxies traffic, but they cannot guarantee access from every ISP or on every day. - Filtering conditions change often. If one configuration stops working, try another one or refresh the subscription. - Public configurations are shared infrastructure. Avoid sensitive activity on them. - Provided for educational and research purposes. Use responsibly and in accordance with local laws.
